Quality Check
```{r}
# ---- Package Installation and Loading ----
if (!requireNamespace("DESeq2")) install.packages("BiocManager"); BiocManager::install("DESeq2")
if (!requireNamespace("pheatmap")) install.packages("pheatmap")
if (!requireNamespace("RColorBrewer")) install.packages("RColorBrewer")
if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2")) install.packages("ggplot2")
if (!requireNamespace("vsn")) BiocManager::install("vsn")

library(DESeq2)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggplot2)
library(vsn)

# ---- Load Data ----
metadata <- read.csv("ColData.csv")
Count_Data <- read.csv("Merged_Count.csv", row.names = 1, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)

# ---- Create DESeqDataSet ----
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = Count_Data,
                              colData = metadata,
                              design = ~ 1)  # no model yet, just QC

# ---- Filter Low Count Genes ----
dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds) >= 5) >= 3, ]
miRNA_for_background <- rownames(dds)  # Background list for DIANA

# Save the background miRNAs
write.table(
  miRNA_for_background,
  file = "DIANA_background_miRNAs.txt",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = FALSE
)

# ---- Basic Statistics ----
# Count statistics
max_count <- max(counts(dds))  # Maximum count
min_count <- min(counts(dds))  # Minimum count
median_count <- median(colSums(counts(dds)))  # Median library size

cat("Max counts:", max_count, "\nMin counts:", min_count, "\nMedian library size:", median_count, "\n")

# Library size distribution (raw counts)
raw_library_sizes <- colSums(counts(dds))
barplot(
  raw_library_sizes,
  las = 2,
  main = "Library sizes",
  ylab = "Total counts"
)

# ---- Raw and Normalized Counts Comparison ----
# Estimate size factors
dds_fit <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)

# Total counts: raw and normalized
raw_totals <- colSums(counts(dds, normalized = FALSE))
norm_totals <- colSums(counts(dds_fit, normalized = TRUE))

# Combine totals for plotting
all_totals <- rbind(raw = raw_totals, normalized = norm_totals)

# Barplot comparison
barplot(
  all_totals,
  beside = TRUE,
  las = 2,
  col = c("skyblue", "lightgreen"),
  main = "Library sizes: raw vs normalized",
  ylab = "Total counts"
)
legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c("Raw", "Normalized"),
  fill = c("skyblue", "lightgreen")
)
```


PCA Analysis
```{r}
# PCA (numerical) using VST + prcomp on top variable genes
library(DESeq2)
library(matrixStats)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(123)

# ---- 0. Load Data & Align ----
counts <- read.csv("Merged_Count.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
coldata <- read.csv("ColData.csv", row.names = 1)
common <- intersect(colnames(counts), rownames(coldata))
counts <- counts[, common, drop = FALSE]
coldata <- coldata[common, , drop = FALSE]

# ---- 1. DESeqDataSet and Filter Low-count Features ----
dds0 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts, colData = coldata, design = ~ 1)
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds0) >= 5) >= 3
dds0 <- dds0[keep, ]

# ---- 2. Variance Stabilizing Transformation (VST) ----
vsd <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds0, blind = TRUE)
mat <- assay(vsd)

# ---- 3. Select Top Variable Genes ----
n_top <- 500
rv <- rowVars(mat)
top_genes <- order(rv, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(min(n_top, length(rv)))]
mat_top <- mat[top_genes, , drop = FALSE]

# ---- 4. Perform PCA ----
pc <- prcomp(t(mat_top), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
percentVar <- 100 * (pc$sdev^2) / sum(pc$sdev^2)
pvar_df <- tibble(PC = paste0("PC", seq_along(percentVar)), PercentVariance = percentVar)

# Sample scores
scores <- as.data.frame(pc$x) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
  left_join(rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(coldata), var = "Sample"), by = "Sample")

# Gene loadings
loadings <- as.data.frame(pc$rotation) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Feature")

# ---- 5. Save Outputs (Uncomment to save) ----
# write.csv(pvar_df, "PCA_percent_variance.csv", row.names = FALSE)
# write.csv(scores, "PCA_sample_scores.csv", row.names = FALSE)
# write.csv(loadings, "PCA_feature_loadings_topGenes.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# ---- 6. Correlation Analysis ----
run_correlation <- function(x, y, method = c("pearson", "spearman"), B = 5000, exact = FALSE) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  complete_idx <- complete.cases(x, y)
  x <- x[complete_idx]
  y <- y[complete_idx]
  
  # Correlation test
  cor_res <- cor.test(x, y, method = method, exact = if (method == "spearman") exact else NULL)
  
  # Bootstrap
  boot_vals <- replicate(B, {
    idx <- sample(seq_along(x), replace = TRUE)
    cor(x[idx], y[idx], method = method)
  })
  
  boot_CI <- quantile(boot_vals, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
  
  list(cor_test = cor_res, boot_CI = boot_CI, n = length(x))
}

# Run correlation analysis (Pearson & Spearman)
PCs <- c("PC1", "PC2")
predictor <- "mvpa_trimester2"
B <- 5000

for (pc in PCs) {
  # Pearson correlation
  res_pearson <- run_correlation(scores[[pc]], coldata[[predictor]], method = "pearson", B = B)
  cat("\nPearson Correlation -", pc, "\n")
  print(res_pearson$cor_test)
  cat("Bootstrap 95% CI:\n")
  print(res_pearson$boot_CI)
  
  # Spearman correlation
  res_spearman <- run_correlation(scores[[pc]], coldata[[predictor]], method = "spearman", exact = TRUE, B = B)
  cat("\nSpearman Correlation -", pc, "\n")
  print(res_spearman$cor_test)
  cat("Bootstrap 95% CI:\n")
  print(res_spearman$boot_CI)
}

# ---- 7. PCA Plot with Convex Hull ----
df <- scores %>%
  mutate(
    mvpa_group = factor(
      coldata$mvpa_quartile_trimester2,
      levels = c("Lower than or equal to 12.9", "Interquartile range", "Greater than or equal to 41.4")
    )
  )

hull_df <- df %>%
  group_by(mvpa_group) %>%
  filter(n() >= 3) %>%
  slice(chull(PC1, PC2))

ggplot(df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = mvpa_group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_polygon(data = hull_df, aes(fill = mvpa_group), alpha = 0.25, color = NA) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Lower than or equal to 12.9" = "red", "Interquartile range" = "darkgreen", "Greater than or equal to 41.4" = "royalblue")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Lower than or equal to 12.9" = "red", "Interquartile range" = "darkgreen", "Greater than or equal to 41.4" = "royalblue")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(color = "SED60+ T2 Quartile", fill = "SED60+ T2 Quartile")

# ---- 8. Regression Plot ----
plot_df <- scores %>%
  mutate(
    Predictor = coldata[[predictor]],
    Quartile = factor(coldata$mvpa_quartile_trimester2)
  )

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Predictor, y = PC2, color = Quartile)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", se = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Lower than or equal to 12.9" = "red", "Interquartile range" = "darkgreen", "Greater than or equal to 41.4" = "royalblue")) +
  labs(
    title = "PC2 vs. MVPA (T1) by Quartile",
    x = "Minutes/day in moderate to vigorous activity",
    y = "PC2",
    color = "Quartile"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```

miRNA Data Analysis
```{r}
# ---- Load Libraries ----
library(DESeq2)
library(tidyverse)

# ---- Load Data ----
counts <- read.csv("Merged_Count.csv", row.names = 1, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)
coldata <- read.csv("ColData.csv", row.names = 1)

# ---- Sedentary Behavior Analysis ----
# Trimester 1
coldata_filt <- coldata %>%
  dplyr::select(sed60num_quartile_trimester1) %>%
  filter(sed60num_quartile_trimester1 != "Interquartile range") %>%
  mutate(SedGroupT1 = ifelse(grepl("Lower", sed60num_quartile_trimester1),
                             "Low", "High")) %>%
  dplyr::select(SedGroupT1)

rownames(coldata_filt) <- rownames(coldata)[rownames(coldata) %in% rownames(coldata_filt)]
coldata_filt$SedGroupT1 <- factor(coldata_filt$SedGroupT1, levels = c("Low", "High"))

counts_filt <- counts[, rownames(coldata_filt)]
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_filt, colData = coldata_filt, design = ~ SedGroupT1)
dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
idx <- rowSums(counts(dds, normalized = TRUE) >= 5) >= 3
dds <- dds[idx,]
dds$SedGroupT1 <- relevel(dds$SedGroupT1, ref = "High")
dds <- DESeq(dds)
results_activity_T1 <- results(dds, contrast = c("SedGroupT1", "Low", "High"))
results_activity_T1_DEGs_NAomit <- na.omit(results_activity_T1[which(results_activity_T1$padj < 0.10), ])
write.csv(as.data.frame(results_activity_T1_DEGs_NAomit), "results_activity_T1_DEGs_NAomit.csv")
```

Volcano Plot
```{r}
# ---- Load Library ----
library(EnhancedVolcano)

# ---- Define Volcano Plot Function ----
generate_volcano_plot <- function(results, 
                                  title, 
                                  subtitle, 
                                  pval_cutoff = 0.10, 
                                  fc_cutoff = 0.10, 
                                  ylim_range = c(0, 4), 
                                  xlim_range = c(-4, 6),
                                  point_size = 1.0, 
                                  label_size = 4.0, 
                                  alpha = 0.5, 
                                  max_overlaps = 80, 
                                  legend_labels = c("NS", "Log2FC", "P-value", "P-value + Log2FC"),
                                  legend_position = "right") {
  # Remove NAs and convert results to a DataFrame
  results_naomit <- na.omit(results)
  res_df <- as.data.frame(results_naomit)
  
  # Extract significant candidates
  sig_genes <- res_df %>%
    filter(padj < pval_cutoff) %>%
    rownames()
  
  # Ensure log2FoldChange and padj columns are properly formatted
  res_df$log2FoldChange <- as.numeric(res_df$log2FoldChange)
  res_df$padj <- as.numeric(res_df$padj)
  
  # Plot using EnhancedVolcano
  EnhancedVolcano(
    res_df,
    lab = rownames(res_df),                     # Gene labels
    x = "log2FoldChange",                       # X-axis: Log2 fold change
    y = "padj",                                 # Y-axis: Adjusted p-value
    title = title,                              # Main Title
    subtitle = subtitle,                        # Subtitle
    selectLab = sig_genes,                      # Genes to label
    pCutoff = pval_cutoff,                      # P-value significance threshold
    FCcutoff = fc_cutoff,                       # Fold-change significance threshold
    pointSize = point_size,                     # Adjust point size
    labSize = label_size,                       # Label size
    colAlpha = alpha,                           # Point transparency
    legendLabels = legend_labels,               # Legend labels
    legendPosition = legend_position,           # Legend position
    ylim = ylim_range,                          # Y-axis range
    xlim = xlim_range,                          # X-axis range
    drawConnectors = TRUE,                      # Draw lines to labels
    col = c("gray", "blue", "green", "purple"), # Point colors: NS, Down, Up, Both
    max.overlaps = max_overlaps                 # Maximum label overlaps
  )
}
```

Bubble Plot
```{r}
# ---- Load Library ----
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# Load data
bubble_data <- read_csv("T2_sednum60_pathways.csv")

# Convert pathway name to a factor, organized by timepoint, then significance
bubble_data$`GO Biological Process Complete Term` <- factor(bubble_data$`GO Biological Process Complete Term`, 
                           levels = rev(unique(bubble_data %>% arrange(Bonferroni) %>% pull(`GO Biological Process Complete Term`))))

# Plot bubble plot with fold enrichment instead of count
ggplot(bubble_data, aes(x = "Targets of upregulated miRNAs of:", y = `GO Biological Process Complete Term`)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = `Fold Enrichment`, color = -log10(Bonferroni))) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "viridis", name = "-log10(Bonferroni)") +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Fold Enrichment") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Top Enriched Pathways in Trimester Two",
    x = "minutes/day in bouts ≥60 min in sedentary bouts",
    y = "Enriched GO Term"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9))
```
